independent_checker.checker: independent NumPy pseudo-random replication of every reported allocation, curve, uncertainty comparison, and concentration test

negative_control.control: force uniform variance at p=1 and feed a fabricated nonconcave curve to the second-difference test

primary.claim: Figures 1-2 qualitative n=8 concavity and concentration

exact_published_plot_regeneration.reason: The paper omits m, seeds, Gaussian sample count, optimizer, stopping rule, raw values, and uncertainty.

paper_inputs.correlation: independent or exact +/-1 correlation inside fixed 2x2 blocks

resolved_ambiguity.bernoulli_conditioned_nonempty: independent membership with probability p, matching the Erdos-Renyi figure caption; empty sets are conditioned away because max over an empty set is undefined
resolved_ambiguity.fixed_cardinality: all size-k subsets, matching p=|S_j|/n and Theorem 1.5

primary.scope: Independent numerical replication under both interpretations supported by the paper; not an exact regeneration of unpublished author code or figure pixels.
